structure.unit: Requirements Applicable to Underground Coal Mines; Electricity, Safety, Etc
Ventilation, Mine Gases, and Other Hazardous Conditions

law.text: The mine foreman shall give prompt attention to the removal of each hazardous condition reported to him by any person working in the mine. If it is impracticable to remove a hazardous condition at once, the mine foreman shall notify every person whose safety is threatened by such hazardous condition to remain away from the portion of the mine where the hazardous condition exists.
